ctx.x: So rhythmically it would be in that… kind of like that.

Yeah. I remember later in Chicago, one the big bands that came out of that era was the Walter Barnes band. Walter Barnes was from Vicksburg, Mississippi. In fact he went to my mother… he was a boyfriend of my mother‟s youngest sister and he was the one… I‟ve got some wonderful tapes here on Ed Birch. Ed Birch, he passed a couple of years ago, and we grew up together like brothers and I talked to him about this whole era. He worked in Walter Barnes‟ band at the Cotton Club when Al Capone opened the Cotton Club…
What kind of music did Walter Barnes play?
